label: Order
caption: WEST FLAGLER ASSOCIATES, LTD., ET AL., Applicants V. DEBRA HAALAND, SECRETARY OF THE INTERIOR, ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, case No. 21-5265 (consolidated with 22-5022), is hereby recalled and stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Wednesday, October 18, 2023, by 5 p.m., EDT.
